TEST FIXTURE - NOT REAL POLICY
Sample Order 99.1 - Vehicle Pursuits (invented text for software testing only)
Revised: 01/2020

1. PURPOSE
This invented sample exists only to test document splitting and search. It does not describe any agency's rules. A vehicle pursuit in this sample is an attempt to stop a fleeing driver.

2. STARTING A PURSUIT
In this invented sample, an officer may start a vehicle pursuit only for a violent felony. The officer must tell the radio dispatcher the location, direction, speed, and reason for the pursuit.

3. SUPERVISOR DUTIES
In this invented sample, a supervisor must monitor the pursuit by radio and must end it when the danger to the public outweighs the need to catch the driver.

4. REPORTING
In this invented sample, the officer completes a pursuit report before the end of the shift and the supervisor reviews it within seven days.
